title: Paloma Business Treasury Rate Card: Size Rate for Debit-Card Deposits
content:
The card deposit rate of a Paloma Business debit-card deposit is worked out from its size rate, decided by the amount of that deposit, the most recent debit-card deposit on the account's ledger.

| Amount of the debit-card deposit | Size rate |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 USD or more | 1.80 percent |
| 2500.00 USD up to 9999.99 USD | 2.20 percent |
| Below 2500.00 USD | The plan's card deposit fee percentage |

As a clause: a deposit of 10000.00 USD or more has a size rate of 1.80 percent; a deposit of 2500.00 USD up to 9999.99 USD has a size rate of 2.20 percent; a smaller deposit has the plan's card deposit fee percentage as its size rate.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical deposits)

| Deposit | Size rate |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 USD | 1.80 percent |
| 9999.99 USD | 2.20 percent |
| 2500.00 USD | 2.20 percent |
| 2499.99 USD on Paloma Business Scale | The plan's card deposit fee percentage, 2.20 on that plan |
| 2499.99 USD on Paloma Business Starter | The plan's card deposit fee percentage, 2.90 on that plan |
